【譯文0】As in previous years, Apple is expected to follow its usual pattern and unveil the iPhone 18 series this coming September, though this year's launch event will echo the unusual circumstances surrounding its iPhone announcements during the COVID-19 pandemic in 2020 in several ways.

【譯文1】How this fall's iPhone unveiling could differ from Apple's typical approach

【譯文2】Apple has many highly successful products, but the iPhone remains its flagship and accounts for a significant share of the company's overall revenue.

【譯文3】It therefore makes sense that Apple works hard to maintain consistency in its iPhone release cadence. By keeping a steady schedule for new iPhone launches, Apple can better meet the expectations of Wall Street and consumers alike.

【譯文4】Generally speaking, Apple unveils its new iPhones in early September, typically announcing four new models at once, with all versions going on sale by the end of September.

【譯文5】2020 was the exception, however, as the COVID-19 pandemic was in full swing at the time.

【譯文6】That fall's iPhone lineup wasn't announced until October, and only two of the new models went on sale first, with the remaining two launching in November.

【譯文7】Rumors suggest Apple's launch plans this year could face similar variables.

【譯文8】While a September event remains the widespread expectation, Apple may not put all new iPhone models on sale simultaneously.

【譯文9】As in 2020, only two models may be available for purchase initially: the iPhone 18 Pro and the iPhone 18 Pro Max.

【譯文10】The much-anticipated foldable iPhone Ultra is expected to make its debut in September, but rumors suggest its release date may be pushed back slightly, potentially arriving a few weeks after the Pro models go on sale.

【譯文11】Apple may also break with its usual practice when it comes to the total number of iPhone models.

【譯文12】If rumors of the iPhone 18 and iPhone Air 2 being delayed until spring 2027 prove accurate, only three new models will be unveiled this fall — making it the smallest fall iPhone lineup since 2019.

【譯文13】Whether for strategic reasons or due to challenges such as the global memory chip shortage and the complexities of mass-producing an entirely new foldable device, Apple's fall 2026 launch event has the potential to recreate several elements of 2020.

【譯文14】What are you most hoping to see at this fall's iPhone event? Let us know in the comments.
